profile.Name: Hobbs
profile.Personality: A teller of tall tales who is not much of a fighter. Nobody knows which of his stories are true, and he may not know either.
profile.Backstory: A wanderer of uncertain history who has lived near the Deadcat villages in the north.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Long-winded; always building up to the good part of a story, whatever the moment.
